name: Upwork
priceNote: No subscription on Basic; 5% marketplace fee plus a per-contract fee, on top of freelancer rates

agent.name: Devin
agent.price: Free tier; Pro $20/mo; Teams $80/mo + $40 per dev seat
does: Picks up tickets from Jira, Linear or Slack
Writes code and opens pull requests in the cloud
Works with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket

whatYouLose: Human judgment on vague or product-heavy tasks
Someone who owns the result and answers questions
Usage limits mean heavy work costs extra
notes: Devin handles well-scoped backlog tickets that you might otherwise farm out to a junior contractor. You still need an engineer to review every pull request.
